envelope.description: Route the tracker resolver through the shared head

body.title: Route the tracker resolver through the shared head
body.summary: In resolve.ts: readEpicIdentity maps readEpicDefinitionCore's result to {epicSlug, createdAt, tracker?}; listEpicHashes appends hashes that have an LLD and no DEF/ISSUE; resolveByLabel's unscoped tiering gains a last tier for LLD-headed hashes; readEpicDefinition stays DEF/ISSUE-only.
acceptanceChecks: S001/t1 + epicHash, s1/t1 + epicHash and the hierarchical id resolve to a task for an LLD+PLAN-only work item.
Unscoped s1/t1 over a mixed DEF + ISSUE + LLD-only fixture resolves exactly as before.
insrc_build_step implement admits t1 of a standalone plan (was unresolved-target).
workflowIdForIssue for a DEF epic with a tracker block is unchanged.

tests.name: readEpicIdentity and listEpicHashes over DEF/ISSUE/LLD fixtures
resolveWorkflowRef reaches an LLD+PLAN-only task by scoped label and hierarchical id
unscoped label tiering over a mixed DEF + ISSUE + LLD-only fixture
insrc_build_step implement + validate admit t1 of a standalone plan
workflowIdForIssue unchanged for a DEF epic with a tracker block
existing id-resolve, folder-identity, storage and migrate-docs-tree suites pass
